cc:Work.dc:title: Alice and Benjamin: efficiency and distribution
cc:Work.dc:description: Interior contract curve x_2^A=1. P=(1,1) and E=(3,1) are both efficient. The curves through E are tangent with slope -1; endpoints are excluded only from the interior set.
